name: save-boot-16-walk-l-up
description: #168 fresh budget, attempt 1 (diagnostic walk). Boot disc1-mktinn and load, then hold up for 160 frames with no wait (so nothing can time out after the load) and 20 still frames. x_dir / y_dir: the sign of the player's PosX / PosY change over the walk (the camera mapping here). n1..n4: each model's talk-distance sign from the player at the end (-1 within TalkRange + the player's SolidRange). win0: window 0's state at the end (not 0 if walking alone opened a message). Only signs, the state and load_done leave.
